notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.notes: [p]We're excited to announce that [i]IdleDownloadManager[/i] will officially launch on [b]November 25, 2025 at 3:00 PM GMT+1[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you[/h3][p]We've never expected to have as much interest in our small utility app as we've gotten so far. Thank you sincerely for your support and interest in IdleDownloadManager.[/p][p][/p][p]~ Chmura Software[/p]

notes.title: IdleDownloadManager Demo now available!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602348/e6c28c03650b2df4e0e0474c719bccbed7f5cbf2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’re excited to share that the [i]IdleDownloadManager[/i] demo is now live!
The demo lets you try out the core download monitoring features so you can see how it works before deciding if it’s right for you.[/p][p][/p][h3]Features[/h3][p]With the demo, you can:[/p][list][*][p]Monitor your downloads[/p][/*][*][p]Automatically shut down your PC when downloads finish[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve included solely the core app features and we've put a limit on download monitoring sessions that take over 30 minutes for the demo so you can focus on exploring the key features. Features that are not included in the demo version will be greyed out and/or unselectable.[/p][p][/p][h3]Feedback[/h3][p]Your feedback is essential to us to ensure that we provide the best quality download monitoring utility app possible. This was the main reason of releasing a demo before our launch (the date will be communicated soon!). If you spot anything odd, have suggestions, or just want to share your thoughts, please let us know in the Community Hub.[/p][p][/p][h3]Closing word[/h3][p]If you think the demo version of IdleDownloadManager is useful and helps you in any way, we hope the full version will be even more valuable to you. The full version will include all features without restrictions. Stay tuned for our official launch announcement![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you and happy downloading![/p][p][/p][p]~ Chmura Software[/p]
